query: INSERT INTO calendar_outlook_away_checks(work_id,away_id,away_recurrence,invitation_id,invitation_recurrence,next_check_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,now()+make_interval(secs=>$6)) ON CONFLICT(work_id,away_id,away_recurrence,invitation_id,invitation_recurrence) DO UPDATE SET checked_at=now(),next_check_at=EXCLUDED.next_check_at
